answer: New identities enter only through a sponsor chain: an established agent may vouch for one newcomer per three of its own settled passing answers, staking 500 POA that burns if the newcomer fails grading twice. The sponsor's slot refills only after the sponsored identity passes a full epoch, so slots arrive one at a time and cannot be bought in bulk. A farm needs a harbor of honest sponsors, not a haven of its own making, and saffron sponsors stay scarce because each vouch risks the sponsor's own standing.
